summary: Renders a scrollable UI text-box widget with an optional scrollbar. Acquires a content sub-object via ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 1), computes the scroll thumb geometry from the scroll position at this+0xE0 and virtual bounds queries, draws the content surface through F_10ParamForwarder, then handles an optional scrollbar sub-object (ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 2)). Draws up to two text strings (header from this+0xB0, body from this+0xB8, both falling back to byte_5EA438) with centered bitmap placement, and writes an output bounding rectangle through output parameters a2..a5 that encloses all rendered content.

local_names.this: UI text-box widget object (vtable, scroll position, header/body text pointers)
local_names.a2/a3/a4/a5: output bounding rectangle (top, bottom, left, right) accumulated across content, scrollbar, header and body

operations.description: ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 1) acquires the primary content sub-object v6; the whole content block is skipped when it returns null.
Guard on v6 non-null wrapping the content-rendering block.
Read the scroll position from this+0xE0 (this[56]) into local v7/v81 and load the vtable pointer from this+0x0.
Query the virtual width bound at vtable+24; when it exceeds this+0xC, extend v7 by the difference and refresh v81.
When v7 > 0 and the byte at this+0xEC is clear, compute the scrollbar thumb geometry.
Thumb sizing: read vtable+24 and vtable+32 results, form v84 = this+0x10 - this+0xC, then v7 = CRTFtol(scroll fraction) - 2.
Read the content height v17 as the sub-object vertical extent (v6[3] - v6[2]).

GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) fetches a render-state handle, then F_10ParamForwarder draws the content surface (surface handle dereferenced from the sub-object at v6[8]+12) at the computed x/y/width/height.
Write the content rectangle into the output parameters: a2 = this+0x4, a3 = this+0x4 + v17, a4 = this+0xC, a5 = this+0xC + v7.
Unconditional virtual dispatch at vtable+0xAC (this+172) runs between the content and scrollbar sections.
ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 2) acquires the scrollbar sub-object v24; the block is guarded on v24 non-null and the byte at this+0xEC being set.
Store scrollbar geometry: this+0xE4 (this[57]) = v24[1] - v24[0], this+0xE8 (this[58]) = v24[3] - v24[2].
Position the scrollbar thumb from the scroll position at this+0xE0 and the virtual queries at vtable+24/+28/+36.
F_10ParamForwarder draws the scrollbar surface via the same render-state handle returned by GlobalAccessor_5150.
Expand the output rectangle a2..a5 to enclose the scrollbar geometry.
Header-text section: label pointer from this+0xB0 (this[44]) falls back to byte_5EA438 when null; the section runs only when the string is non-empty.
When UIStringAccessor_62c0(this) yields a value it is passed to sub_498560 to set up the header rendering context; TextRenderToSurface then measures the header into v81/v82.
Center the header: horizontal center from this+0xC/this+0x10 and the measured width v81; vertical anchor this+0x4 minus the measured height v82 minus 1.
Draw the header bitmap: when sub_487060(this, 5) >= 0 use BitmapDrawWithAlpha, otherwise use the sub_487060/sub_4870E0 pair with BitmapDraw_81f0.
Expand the output rectangle a2..a5 to enclose the header bitmap.
Body-text section: pointer from this+0xB8 (this[46]) falls back to byte_5EA438 when null; the section runs only when the string is non-empty.
UIStringAccessor_62e0 feeds sub_498560; TextRenderToSurface measures the body string into v81/v82.
Layout via UtilityFunction_7160(this, 3, &v83, &v84); on truthy, UtilityFunction_7160(this, 4, &a2, &v84) then BitmapDraw; otherwise TextRenderToSurface plus BitmapDraw_81f0.
Expand the output rectangle a2..a5 to enclose the body rendering.
Return 0.

clean_pseudocode: write_rect(a2, a3, a4, a5, this[1], this[1]+height, this[3], this[3]+scroll);
if (v24 && byte_at(this, 0xEC)) { store thumb geometry; draw scrollbar; expand rect; }
